# Depop's "0% selling fee" is not the same as free.

> Free Depop seller fee calculator for the US and UK schedule (0% selling fee, 3.3%+$0.45 or 2.9%+£0.30 processing on item price + shipping) and the rest-of-world flat 10% schedule, plus Boosted Listings. Real profit, price for a target profit, and a region-by-region comparison. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
